title: SUSPENDING CALLBACK
message:
This function must not suspend: `sealJob` hands it on to a function that calls
it synchronously.

But it may suspend: it calls `Task.yieldNow`, which suspends.

Hint: a function called synchronously cannot wait for anything. Do the work that
suspends before handing this function over, and pass it what that work produced.
